title: Spora Skill
description: A Spora skill — a versionable, file-backed bundle of operator knowledge. The SKILL.md frontmatter carries the skill's identity (name + short description); the Markdown body is the skill's instructions. Optional sidecar files (e.g. examples.md) are listed by the Skill tool's `files` operation and read on demand by `read`. Conforms to the open Agent Skills format (https://agentskills.io/specification).

name.description: Skill slug. 1-64 chars, lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens, no leading/trailing hyphen, no consecutive hyphens. Must match the parent directory name.

description.description: Short description surfaced to the LLM at tool-definition time (Stage 1 of progressive disclosure). Should describe both what the skill does and when to use it; include trigger keywords that help the model identify relevant tasks.

license.description: License name or reference to a bundled license file. Informational only — surfaced in the skill summary.

compatibility.description: Environment requirements (intended product, system packages, network access). Surfaced in the skill summary.

metadata.description: Free-form string→string map. Use reasonably unique key names to avoid conflicts with other tooling.

allowed-tools.description: (Spec-experimental) Space-separated list of pre-approved tools the skill may use. Parsed but not enforced by Spora in MVP; tracked as future work in spora-workspace/backlog/skills-allowed-tools-enforcement.md.
